section: 3. Automated Environmental Alarm Response Rules: Humidity High
condition_text: Relative humidity >45% RH for >5 continuous minutes
action_text: Trigger Yellow Alarm, reduce fresh air damper to 30% open, notify Shift Lead
note: Continuous 5-minute condition.

section: 3. Automated Environmental Alarm Response Rules: Humidity Critical
condition_text: Relative humidity >55% RH for >2 minutes
action_text: Trigger Red Alarm, shut down PC-03 plasma gas supply, evacuate bay within 90 seconds
note: Evacuation must complete within 90 s after alarm.

section: 3. Automated Environmental Alarm Response Rules: Temperature Drift
condition_text: Average zone temperature deviates from 21.0C by +/-1.5C for >10 minutes
action_text: Adjust chilled water valve to compensate, log event; if deviation persists >30 min, escalate to Amber Alarm
note: Two-stage response: automatic adjustment then escalation.

section: 3. Automated Environmental Alarm Response Rules: Airborne Particle Spike
condition_text: 0.5 micron particle count >1000 particles/m3 for >3 consecutive minutes on any sensor
action_text: Disable AOI-04 conveyor and hold current lot for QA review
note: Conveyor halt and lot quarantine.

section: 3. Automated Environmental Alarm Response Rules: Differential Pressure Loss
condition_text: Bay-to-gowning pressure falls below 15 Pa for >10 sec
action_text: Close all bay doors, sound audible alert, switch air handlers to recirculation mode
note: Immediate containment action.

section: 3. Automated Environmental Alarm Response Rules: Exhaust Duct Failure
condition_text: Exhaust flow drops below 80 SCFM for >5 sec
action_text: Cut power to plasma generator, close process gas valves
note: Safety interlock to prevent gas buildup.

section: 3. Automated Environmental Alarm Response Rules: E-Stop Activation
condition_text: Any emergency stop button pressed
action_text: De-energise all equipment in the row within 1 second; log station ID; notify Safety Officer via pager
note: Immediate row shutdown.
